'available' is the operator switch (DECISION_ANALYTICS_ENABLED with the model available); 'enabled' is that and the agent's own analytics switch. The sweep labels only the last 'backfill_days' (from 'labelling_from'), so coverage splits unlabelled answers into 'unlabelled_recent_turns' (still to be labelled) and 'unlabelled_older_turns' (never labelled without a backfill). For an agent, 'one_pick' lists the options of its topic question (empty when it asks none) and 'overlapping' its topics that can overlap; each one's totals are under 'tag:<id>'. Topics ('topic_effective') are reported for an agent only: each agent has its own list. 'series' is in 'bucket_unit': the filter's own unit while its buckets average 10 analyzed answers, else the next coarser one (minute to hour, hour to day, day to week). A week is named by its first day in the window and carries its last as 'bucket_end'. 'previous' holds answer_status, reaction and sentiment totals over the period of the same length just before the window.
